members.scopeSummary: `npm audit` began reporting a high advisory against zod on 2026-10-23, GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (_"Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections"_, every `zod <4.6.6`), which made CI's dependency-audit gate fail closed for every PR into `develop`. There is no patched 3.x, so this REQ upgrades `zod` 3.25.76 → 4.6.7 and `@hookform/resolvers` 3.10.0 → 5.9.2 (its 3.x supports zod 3 only). The operator chose fixing over risk-acceptance. The upgrade is behaviour-preserving: same accept/reject rules and the same error messages users see, verified against zod 3.25.76 itself.
